summary:
AI2Bharat (Next.js + Neon + Azure Foundry, AGPL platform / CC BY-SA content) is a production bilingual EN/HI community that teaches adults AI human-feedback work. origin/main@a11c521 (Round 21, 2026-09-14) is a re-rooted history; the four in-scope branches (community df2866c, opportunity-ingestion 22ce046, rlhf-learning-onboarding fe6ac72, neon-member-platform 2e72358) are file-tree subsets of main and add value only as commit-history (rejections, measurements from 08-27..09-01).
Catalog: 21 pathways, 164 lessons, 46 quests across a 5-level content ladder (L0 Shuruaat..L4 Ustaad); nothing is locked; levels describe content, never people.
Lesson loop: recall (scene prompt, near-miss distractors) -> worked example (weak/strong + reviewer note) -> calibration practice -> changed-situation transfer -> work sample (parcha) -> 3 rubric self-checks; completion recomputed server-side; first-try correctness columns stored once, never shown.
Saathi, the in-lesson AI guide, is the most engineered part: byte-stable CORE/TAIL prompt compiler with 2 appended-last MUST slots, server-side stage gate (answer never shown to the model), 13 fatal output gates + 4 rewrites with negative-control batteries, Phase A authored offline fallback, glossary-first, hint ladder, honorific arc aap->tum at 40 turns, celebration licence, bubble pacing, pull-only context windows, six-kind no-affect member-visible memory with hard delete, push-to-talk Hinglish ASR never auto-sent, homework photo with canvas EXIF strip, paid-lane data-terms assertion, DB daily spend cap that fails closed.
Measured: grok-4-1-fast question share 67.8% -> 41.5% (bounding slot 2) -> 23-26% (scoped trim gate), n~320 per run; $0.000371/turn; p50 1.0 s; gpt-4.1-mini and DeepSeek rejected on measurement.
Platform: Neon member schema with RLS + security-definer writers, append-only consent ledger, learning sync with optimistic versions, Sahyog Trail (points only from finished work, level floor), spaced review 2/7/21/60 with kept/faded only, outbound shape gate (no re-engagement/streak/loss), privacy-safe analytics k>=5, responsive-audit instrument (2,912 cells), DESIGN.md tokens and 13-script self-hosted fonts.
Three deliberate refusals collide with Taxila: no stored affect (D-057), no realtime voice (D-061, reversal = byte-identical CORE via lane-identity digest), not-a-person (no avatar/cloned voice). The RLHF onboarding branch onboards learners INTO human-feedback work; it does not learn the learner — Taxila must build profile discovery itself (only a 3-value explanation-style kind exists). Population was tiny (15 members), so learning-outcome efficacy is unmeasured. DPDP: children <18 need verifiable parental consent and behavioural monitoring of children is prohibited (s.9(3)) — affects covert comprehension and emotional OS design.

assets.title: CORE/TAIL compiler
assets.what: CORE/TAIL compiler. CORE (8,000 B cap) is byte-stable and learner-independent, with the two must-fire rules re-appended *after* any trim. TAIL (6,000 B) holds stop rows, authored lesson rows filtered for live answers, `[REMEMBERED]`, `[PHOTO]`, `[WINDOW]` (dropped from the oldest end first) and `[NOW]` (the learner's turn always last). Truncation is reported on the trace.

assets.title: The tutor sheet as telegraphic `key
assets.what: The tutor sheet as telegraphic `key: value` / `a -> b` rows in sections WHO, REGISTER, HOW-TO-TEACH, ON-A-MOMENT, NOT-BUILT, USING-MEMORY and FLOOR, plus ALWAYS: exactly 2 must-fire-last rules. It includes `firstMoveOnDoubt: ask-what-was-tried -> restate-back -> then content`, `explanationOrder … -> hand-back-the-next-move`, the hint ladder, `onWrongAttempt`, `afterAFeeling`, the closed 8-glyph emoji set and the banned affection set. Every row carries an inline note on what was measured.

assets.title: A lint that every sheet row and every memory row must pass
assets.what: A lint that every sheet row and every memory row must pass. It rejects first-person rows, sentence-shaped rows (`^[A-Z][^.?!]*[.?!]$`), and any segment over 14 words.

assets.title: The academic-integrity spine
assets.what: The academic-integrity spine. `checkedStepsForStage` (understand→conceptCheck; practice→practice+transferCheck; apply→rubricChecks) feeds `classifyIntent`, which re-derives intent server-side from regex shapes in English and Hinglish, which feeds the `refusalFor` table. `judge-my-work` and `judge-my-readiness` are always blocked.

assets.title: Fatal gates
assets.what: Fatal gates: empty-200, leaked-answer (literal + normalized), verdict-shaped (EN/HI regexes, with the option-letter fix), ability-praise, unlicensed-celebration, register (Devanagari the learner did not open), emoji-banned / off-vocabulary, cut-off (`endsUnfinished`), and Round-13 question-trim for two intents. Rewrites are limited to stripping non-allowlisted URLs, em/en/double dashes (the ASCII hyphen is preserved) and a second use of the learner's name.

assets.title: Doubt escalation ladder
assets.what: Doubt escalation ladder: rung 1 *orient* (re-read named section) → rung 2 *authored constraint* → rung 3 *how options were built* (near-miss explanation) → stop + "a wrong answer costs nothing". The rung is derived server-side from history, rungs are leak-filtered, and the full answer is never a rung.

assets.title: Phase A
assets.what: Phase A: answers from the authored lesson with no model and no network. Retrieval is deterministic: a question shape picks a candidate list, and the first non-leaking authored candidate wins. It is the fallback for every gate trip, missing credential or ledger failure.

assets.title: A word question gets the authored glossary entry verbatim, ahead of the hint ladder
assets.what: A word question gets the authored glossary entry verbatim, ahead of the hint ladder. Its provenance is labelled `glossary` or `glossary-other` ("Words from another lesson").

assets.title: Distress regexes in English, Hinglish and Devanagari, each with negative controls
assets.what: Distress regexes in English, Hinglish and Devanagari, each with negative controls. One list has three callers: the prompt (reasoning OFF on distress), never-store (refuse to write) and the panel (renders the helpline from `copy.ts`, keyed on the learner's words). The FLOOR row names Tele-MANAS 14416 and KIRAN 1800-599-0019.

assets.title: An authored, month-keyed table (board-exam-season, semester-end, results-and-admissions, Diwali, Eid, hiring-s
assets.what: An authored, month-keyed table (board-exam-season, semester-end, results-and-admissions, Diwali, Eid, hiring-season). It is matched only against the learner's live turn, emits one telegraphic TAIL row, and can never produce a countdown. Results season forces reasoning off as a *policy* ("self-harm risk … peaks").

assets.title: Honorific as state
assets.what: Honorific as state: `honorificFor(lifetimeGuideTurns)` returns aap, or tum once turns ≥ 40. The type has two members, so `tu` is unreachable. The row lives in TAIL so it never splits the CORE cache.

assets.title: First name derived server-side from the profile, re-guarded for injection
assets.what: First name derived server-side from the profile, re-guarded for injection. TAIL row only. The gate removes a second use and any use inside a correction or refusal; the correction predicate leans inclusive.

assets.title: Celebration licence
assets.what: Celebration licence. There are four client-recorded events: first-attempt-after-stuck, work-sample-saved, stage-advanced, returned-after-a-gap. With no `moment:` row, celebration shapes are discarded. Saathi celebrates events, never quality, praises method, never ability, and never forecasts.

assets.title: Deterministic bubble split *after* the gate
assets.what: Deterministic bubble split *after* the gate: max 3 bubbles, split only above 140 chars, protected spans for URLs, code and quotes. Pacing: 66 ms/char, 400–900 ms, jitter 0.8–1.3, first bubble immediate, total capped at 1.8 s. The model is never told bubbles exist.

assets.title: A 12-pair table of catalog words → their ASR mishearings (`rubric←lubric`, `calibration←celebration`)
assets.what: A 12-pair table of catalog words → their ASR mishearings (`rubric←lubric`, `calibration←celebration`). Pulled only on voice turns whose transcript contains the wrong half, and emitted as one `heard-by-voice:` TAIL row.

assets.title: A `promptDigest(core, tail)` that is length-prefixed SHA-256 over the bytes extracted back out of the serializ
assets.what: A `promptDigest(core, tail)` that is length-prefixed SHA-256 over the bytes extracted back out of the serialized wire body. The handler discards a turn on mismatch (`prompt-fork`). This is the mechanism the realtime-lane reversal condition needs.

assets.title: One shared predicate file (`endsInQuestion`, emoji, Devanagari, em-dash, shortform, word count) used by the pu
assets.what: One shared predicate file (`endsInQuestion`, emoji, Devanagari, em-dash, shortform, word count) used by the public benchmark, the register battery and the output gate, so the gate and the eval cannot disagree.

assets.title: The help assistant (Sahayata)
assets.what: The help assistant (Sahayata). It answers from a written handbook, and a claims gate runs over model output, canned copy and the *grounding fact set*. Negation-aware.

assets.title: Six closed kinds, each with its own rules
assets.what: Six closed kinds, each with its own rules: weak-topic (event, 12, decays), misconception (statement, 20, ≤14 words), explanation-style (statement, 1 row, enum example-first/rule-first/smallest-case-first), goal (3), context-given (6, keys calls-me/language/role/studying/works-on/state), term-asked (event, 20). The total cap is 62 = the sum of the per-kind caps. `source` is a closed union, `explicit-learner-statement` or `recorded-learning-event`, and there is no `model-inference`.

assets.title: The no-affect boundary in two layers
assets.what: The no-affect boundary in two layers. The app filter reuses the `distressShapes` list. A DB CHECK applies a word-boundary affect vocabulary (EN + romanized + Devanagari) to `note`, and to `subject` for learner-text kinds, plus a verdict vocabulary (score/grade/smart/employable…). Field scoping is deliberate: `trainer-pairwise-rank` contains "rank".
assets.notes: use note: (Taxila must decide what affect it stores)

assets.title: Deterministic extraction with no second model call
assets.what: Deterministic extraction with no second model call. Filter order: authored shape → word cap (fail, never trim) → never-store → forget terms → dedupe → cap. At most 2 rows per turn. Includes authored Hinglish shapes for style, goal, context and misconception ("X ka matlab Y hai").

assets.title: RANK = salience × RECENCY (decaying kinds fall to a 0.25 floor over 90 days) × (1 + 0.35·ln(1+mentions)) × SPA
assets.what: RANK = salience × RECENCY (decaying kinds fall to a 0.25 floor over 90 days) × (1 + 0.35·ln(1+mentions)) × SPACED (0.6 if recalled <20 h ago, 1.25 if untouched >21 d). The "matched" column is a word-boundary regex against the live turn only. One reserved seat goes to the oldest row with salience ≥ 2.0 and is dropped first. A test greps the SQL for any due-branch outside the ORDER BY.

assets.title: Forgetting has one concept and three doors (one row, everything, stop remembering)
assets.what: Forgetting has one concept and three doors (one row, everything, stop remembering). Each is a hard delete plus a forget term in one transaction, and no table has `deleted_at`. "ye bhool jao" is classified by narrow authored shapes and acted on before the reply. The receipt is three-branch: worked / nothing there / failed.

assets.title: Append-only consent ledger with no content column
assets.what: Append-only consent ledger with no content column. UPDATE is blocked; DELETE is allowed so an erasure can cascade.

assets.title: Member-visible memory
assets.what: Member-visible memory: "every row shown in the words it is stored in", the never-store list printed beside it, and both consent choices at equal weight. The memory line on the home screen shows the top recall row verbatim, before the lesson.

assets.title: Memory is an injected, optional slot
assets.what: Memory is an injected, optional slot. With memory off, the TAIL is byte-identical to a build without memory, and the prompt-budget test asserts it per module, stage and locale ("declining costs nothing").

assets.title: A push-to-talk state machine with no send event
assets.what: A push-to-talk state machine with no send event: idle/arming/recording/transcribing/transcript/error. There is a 45 s self-enforced cap and cancel discards the clip. The sheet probes `/api/saathi/asr` first, so there is never a dead microphone.
assets.notes: use note: (idea for realtime barge-in UX)

assets.title: A Sarvam ASR seam (`saarika:v3`)
assets.what: A Sarvam ASR seam (`saarika:v3`). The pool rotates only on 402/429 or a credit message, not on transport failures, and tries each key at most once. Failures are named (no-key, pool-exhausted, unsupported-audio, size, network, deadline, http_status, empty). No audio is ever persisted.

assets.title: Photo of homework
assets.what: Photo of homework. EXIF is stripped by canvas re-encode (pixels only). `createImageBitmap` applies orientation. JPEG/WebP only; HEIC is refused. The same caps are validated on client and route. Nothing is stored.

assets.title: Photo predicates
assets.what: Photo predicates. An illegibility claim beside an ungrounded assertion discards the whole turn. Identifiers not found in typed words or the lesson are stripped. Handwriting commentary and transcription are refused. The stage gate withholds the image on checked steps.

assets.title: A paid-lane assertion
assets.what: A paid-lane assertion. No provider is built unless `MODEL_LANE_DATA_TERMS=paid` and a data-terms record exists (terms URL, date read, `paidTierTrainingUse=false`). An interim unpaid acknowledgement expires after 60 days and marks every trace. Data-terms record R-027: Foundry's default abuse monitoring allows human review, so apply for modified abuse monitoring before sending minors' photos.

assets.title: Foundry `v1` chat lane with a 12 s fuse
assets.what: Foundry `v1` chat lane with a 12 s fuse. It reads `finish_reason` (length → fail) and reports cached tokens and estimated USD on every turn. Paid pools rotate on a daily spend estimate, not on status codes.

assets.title: One table maps feature → deployment via `AI2_MODEL_<FEATURE>`, and no model name appears in code
assets.what: One table maps feature → deployment via `AI2_MODEL_<FEATURE>`, and no model name appears in code. It refuses Saathi by name (Saathi has its own compliance lane), never retries except one 404 fallback, and keeps keys out of traces.

assets.title: Daily USD cap per feature from a DB ledger
assets.what: Daily USD cap per feature from a DB ledger: grain (day, feature), no member column, additive security-definer writer, 60 s hot cache. It fails closed to authored content when the ledger is unreadable and never spends on an unpriced deployment. Shares: saathi 0.5, feedback 0.2, translate 0.15, embed/classify/transcribe 0.05 each.

assets.title: Price table, `estimateTurnCostUsd` (upper bound, no cache discount) and env price overrides.
assets.what: Price table, `estimateTurnCostUsd` (upper bound, no cache discount) and env price overrides.

assets.title: A per-turn trace attached to the response
assets.what: A per-turn trace attached to the response: served-by, gate, degraded reason, digest, cached tokens, usd, elapsed, trimmed flags. It carries no text, and only text-free fields reach analytics.

assets.title: The lesson + module + quest + pathway schema described in §1.2, with EN/HI `LocalizedLearningText`, plus the p
assets.what: The lesson + module + quest + pathway schema described in §1.2, with EN/HI `LocalizedLearningText`, plus the per-module record (`conceptSelectedOption`, `*Aligned`, `*Attempts`, `artifactDraft`, `rubricChecks`, stage, status).

assets.title: The studio's 4-stage loop (understand/example/practice/apply), with the recall rules hidden in a disclosure un
assets.what: The studio's 4-stage loop (understand/example/practice/apply), with the recall rules hidden in a disclosure until the recall is answered (Round 15), plus a public no-account first lesson ending on a shareable parcha.

assets.title: The near-miss check rule
assets.what: The near-miss check rule. A scene prompt of 8–25 words from daily Indian life must not contain the answer's distinctive words. The 2 distractors are near-misses of the same rule (right rule/wrong step; wrong source; half applied). Each distractor shares <60% of the answer's content words, and none equals any concept bullet in the corpus. The rationale names each near-miss by position. A test enforces all of it, with EN/HI parity.

assets.title: A server-true record
assets.what: A server-true record: aligned flags are recomputed from the stored option against `correctIndex`. `concept_first_try`, `practice_first_try` and `transfer_first_try` are decided once, never revised, never returned by GET, and never shown. Unearned completions are repaired back to `practising` with a NOTICE.

assets.title: Device ↔ account sync with optimistic `snapshot_version`, idempotency receipts (sha256 request hash) and an ex
assets.what: Device ↔ account sync with optimistic `snapshot_version`, idempotency receipts (sha256 request hash) and an explicit "use account / keep device" conflict choice. The read merge is monotone, so finished work never disappears.

assets.title: Level, quest and band arithmetic (`levelLessonCount` vs `levelQuestBandLessonCount`, with a reconciliation ide
assets.what: Level, quest and band arithmetic (`levelLessonCount` vs `levelQuestBandLessonCount`, with a reconciliation identity), the Safar map and quest/level milestone ids.

assets.title: A deterministic, explainable route plan
assets.what: A deterministic, explainable route plan. It reads only aim + experience + catalog. Every position carries one of 6 bilingual reasons (you-chose-this, builds-the-basics, continues-from, same-family, fits-your-time, open-to-everyone). Nothing is hidden or scored.

assets.title: A level check
assets.what: A level check: 5 authored questions plus one written answer. It blocks nothing, scores nothing and writes nothing, and it marks questions from unopened lessons as such.

assets.title: Spaced retrieval over finished modules on 2/7/21/60-day intervals
assets.what: Spaced retrieval over finished modules on 2/7/21/60-day intervals. Outcomes are `kept`/`faded` only, with no skipped, streak or dueSince field. Overdue items are rescheduled forward to today. The item type carries no date. Questions are the authored checks, verbatim.

assets.title: Criterion-named AI feedback on a draft
assets.what: Criterion-named AI feedback on a draft: 2–4 items of {criterion copied from the lesson, observation, nextStep}. There is no score field. Gates: parse, authored criterion (the authored string is served), verdict/score-number vocab EN+HI, ≤40 words, no >15-word run foreign to the draft and lesson, quote cap, no "write in language X", register, no URL. Discard the whole turn and fall back to authored. Never stored.

assets.title: Rubrics of exactly 3 criteria with 0–5 anchors in EN/HI, version pins (`id vN`) as composite FKs, and publishe
assets.what: Rubrics of exactly 3 criteria with 0–5 anchors in EN/HI, version pins (`id vN`) as composite FKs, and published pages. Each criterion is verbatim a line the quest's lessons teach.

assets.title: Worked exemplars beside the rubric
assets.what: Worked exemplars beside the rubric: a strong and a weaker artefact for the same brief, with margin notes keyed to criteria (met/partly/not-met chips, no numbers), a fingerprint pinned to `authoredOn`, and the boundary sentence "This is a reference, not an answer…".

assets.title: Cohen's κ + percent agreement + Wilson interval
assets.what: Cohen's κ + percent agreement + Wilson interval. It prints `SYNTHETIC` on self-test and refuses to repair bad input.

assets.title: An evidence state machine (exposed→…→published, withdraw terminal), three human gates read from code, founding
assets.what: An evidence state machine (exposed→…→published, withdraw terminal), three human gates read from code, founding-reviewer credentials (named admin, ≤183 days, ≤3 per field), and model triage whose routing type is number-free.

assets.title: Build-time machine translation into 19–21 locales
assets.what: Build-time machine translation into 19–21 locales. Units are keyed by field path against a per-module source hash, and a changed source drops the unit and records it as a `source-changed` gap. There are script-ratio and Latin-leakage checks. Output is labelled "machine-translated beta".

assets.title: Two-judge translation quality scoring (adequacy/fluency 1–5), stratified sampling, and κ.
assets.what: Two-judge translation quality scoring (adequacy/fluency 1–5), stratified sampling, and κ.

assets.title: A Hindi register glossary (287 strings reviewed) and a "no Latin inside a Hindi string" gate with an allowlist
assets.what: A Hindi register glossary (287 strings reviewed) and a "no Latin inside a Hindi string" gate with an allowlist.

assets.title: Readability gate
assets.what: Readability gate: no sentence over 20 words, applied across the lesson corpus and UI copy.
assets.notes: use note: (kid reading levels per class)

assets.title: "One word per thing" lock
assets.what: "One word per thing" lock: banned phrase patterns matched against rendered literals (comments stripped), plus the "certificate" lock.

assets.title: Sahyog Trail
assets.what: Sahyog Trail. Points come only from finished work (practice module, project brief, collaboration card); no points for visits, time, streaks or money. The permanent `levelFloor` means no demotion, `CATALOG_V1_MODULE_COUNT` is frozen at 18, and the ledger is append-only with a server trigger. Level names: beej→sthapak.

assets.title: Opt-in weekly suggestions that structurally cannot see a previous week
assets.what: Opt-in weekly suggestions that structurally cannot see a previous week. Load-bearing copy: "Pick one if it is useful. Nothing happens if you skip it."

assets.title: Circles
assets.what: Circles: presence, never performance. Opt-in, one tap to leave, a server-enforced 5-member floor, real counts only, no DM.
assets.taxila_target: group-ai/multi-agent (cohort presence for kids, only if safe)

assets.title: The NEVER MANIPULATE four-question audit
assets.what: The NEVER MANIPULATE four-question audit: (1) is anything taken away on absence? (2) any nag or shame if ignored? (3) any rank vs others? (4) is the reward inspectable work, not attention? A mechanic passes only if removing fear and obligation leaves it intact.

assets.title: Outbound channel (email, with a WhatsApp adapter slot)
assets.what: Outbound channel (email, with a WhatsApp adapter slot). Four event kinds only. A composer with no free-text parameter. A shape gate refusing re-engagement, elapsed-time, streak and loss language in EN+HI, mirrored as DB checks. No `scheduled_for` and no digest.

assets.title: Privacy-safe analytics
assets.what: Privacy-safe analytics: opt-in, GPC/DNT → essential-only, allowlisted semantic events, no typed content, coordinates or UA. 28-day raw retention, 13-month aggregates, k<5 suppression, withdrawal tombstone, a rollback-only verifier.

assets.title: A weekly cohort aggregate of counts only, sealed at day 30, answering day-7 and day-30 retention without per-m
assets.what: A weekly cohort aggregate of counts only, sealed at day 30, answering day-7 and day-30 retention without per-member rows.

assets.title: Guided tour
assets.what: Guided tour: 7 "moments" of ≤8 words each, fired only from real product state (a test forbids timers), once per device and once per member, replayable.

assets.title: "Kaam ka parcha"
assets.what: "Kaam ka parcha": a finished piece of work gets an opt-in public page and a WhatsApp-sized canvas card. Attributable, with no count or rank.
assets.taxila_target: growth (parent share of a child's work, consented)

assets.title: Profiles (private default, handle regex, terms version/time pair), journeys with ordered intents, handle histo
assets.what: Profiles (private default, handle regex, terms version/time pair), journeys with ordered intents, handle history, rooms/messages with fail-closed attachments (scan_state), avatar genome, RLS + revoke + security-definer writers.

assets.title: Neon Auth that fails closed in production when the URL or cookie secret is incomplete (a per-process random pl
assets.what: Neon Auth that fails closed in production when the URL or cookie secret is incomplete (a per-process random placeholder secret). A deterministic `/auth/complete` router exchanges the verifier and routes to onboarding or home. Safe `next=` destinations refuse 21 shapes. A failed session lookup is distinguished from signed-out.

assets.title: Detects in-app browsers (`; wv)`, FBAN, Instagram, WhatsApp, iOS without a Safari token) and hides Google OAut
assets.what: Detects in-app browsers (`; wv)`, FBAN, Instagram, WhatsApp, iOS without a Safari token) and hides Google OAuth there, because Google returns 403 `disallowed_useragent`. Email OTP is offered instead.

assets.title: An 18+ declaration gate
assets.what: An 18+ declaration gate: `age_declared_at` only, no DOB collected, never backfilled.
assets.notes: use note: (Taxila needs verifiable parental consent instead) / idea

assets.title: Same-origin mutation check, bounded streamed JSON with strict media type, UUID validation before DB casts, per
assets.what: Same-origin mutation check, bounded streamed JSON with strict media type, UUID validation before DB casts, per-member rate limits, plus CSP/HSTS/COOP/CORP headers.

assets.title: Rollback-only verifiers that prove each migration's claims against real Postgres (privileges, triggers, CHECKs
assets.what: Rollback-only verifiers that prove each migration's claims against real Postgres (privileges, triggers, CHECKs). Migrations are applied as a whole file through the Neon WebSocket client, with a branch guard.

assets.title: A durable context memory
assets.what: A durable context memory: nodes/edges, decisions D-###, questions Q-###, risks R-###, a dated timeline, and measurements with n/method/date. The logger rejects credential-shaped values.

assets.title: Tokens
assets.what: Tokens: page `#f4f6f1`, forest `#16342b`, action vermilion `#b8341d`, a semantic dark remap, radii (12 control / 14 card / 20 sheet), the 44 px target floor, 16 px inputs, a one-viewport shell, and the matra-safe rule for Hindi.

assets.title: Self-hosted fonts for 13 Indic scripts (Devanagari, Bengali/Assamese, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, Kannada, Malayalam,
assets.what: Self-hosted fonts for 13 Indic scripts (Devanagari, Bengali/Assamese, Gujarati, Gurmukhi, Kannada, Malayalam, Meetei Mayek, Ol Chiki, Odia, Tamil, Telugu, Nastaliq). A 23-language catalog with BCP-47 tags, native names and direction (ur/ks/sd RTL).

assets.what: A Playwright instrument covering surfaces × 18 viewports × en/hi/ur × light/dark, 10 checks (overflow, clipped text, 44 px targets, text floors, empty bands, occlusion, short-viewport reachability, contrast ≥4.5:1, RTL). It writes a ranked defect index and a contact sheet, and has its own test fixtures.

assets.what: The Bharat Jeev avatar genome: 4,096 deterministic SVG combinations (8 Indian animals × 8 earth palettes × 4 markings × 4 backdrops × 4 moods). Repo-native, with no photo or biometric service, and respects reduced motion.
assets.taxila_target: avatar-visual (child profile avatar, no child photos)

assets.what: Hybrid lexical + 256-dim embedding search with EN/HI/Hinglish synonyms (chhatravritti, sarkari). The normaliser keeps `\p{M}`. Precomputed vectors are committed.

assets.title: Sourced research

assets.what: A "first ninety seconds" study as a Tier-2 first-timer, with 12 ranked frictions, a words-in-fold counter and before/after numbers.

assets.what: Three batteries in cost order: shapes → gates (every predicate paired with a must-not-trip real string) → register (per-intent word bands, question share per band, emoji, Devanagari, em-dash, shortform, lane health, prompt forks, cost meter). The fix: bound it inside the rule ("close on a statement; the last character is never a question mark"). `measurements.md` 2026-09-01; `git diff @rlhf @main -- lib/saathi/pedagogy.ts`.

rejections.what_broke: - "1 question max…" scored 65.4% (n=80). - "ask opens a turn, never closes it. Last line is a statement" scored 74.7%. - Adding a banned comprehension tag scored 77.2%. - "close on the next move they make" scored 64.2% at n=320. concepts.name: Structural gates beat prompt rules
concepts.description: "A rule a model is asked to follow is a preference. A rule checked in code is an invariant." Every must-hold property (answer withholding, verdicts, emoji, register, celebration, photo honesty) is a predicate over output or a filter over input.

concepts.name: Discard, never edit, and build the authored floor first
concepts.description: "Half a leaked answer is still an answer." Phase A (authored, offline) exists so that every gate trip has an honest fallback.

concepts.name: Position is mechanism
concepts.description: Exactly two appended-last slots. The learner's turn always goes last in TAIL. In Round 12, internal clause order inside a slot also proved to matter.

concepts.name: Anything sentence-shaped in a prompt gets recited
concepts.description: Rows are shapes (`a -> b`, `key: value`, `never: x`), enforced by a lint. Sentences the learner may read live in `copy.ts`, which the model never sees.

concepts.name: Byte-stable CORE, volatile TAIL, loud truncation
concepts.description: The cache key is a byte property. A per-learner byte belongs in TAIL.

concepts.name: Absent means absent
concepts.description: A feature that is off, a declined consent, or an unmatched context window leaves TAIL byte-identical. Declining "costs nothing", and a test asserts it.

concepts.name: Never show the model what it must not say
concepts.description: Never show the model what it must not say.

concepts.name: The six inversions from companion to tutor:
concepts.description: honorific as state, not mood; a closed work emoji set with affection banned; no self, backstory or day; no deliberate typos; no opener, notification or re-engagement; no reaction on learner work ("a tick is a verdict with no words").

concepts.name: Celebrate events, never quality; praise method, never ability
concepts.description: Ability praise "is the one praise category measured to change what a learner attempts next".

concepts.name: Pull-only context
concepts.description: Windows, memory, sound-alikes and context rows enter only when the learner's live words match them. "Due-ness" is a rank modifier, never a trigger.

concepts.name: If a row cannot be shown, it must not be stored
concepts.description: This is the test for memory, and it is why affect is excluded.

concepts.name: Two layers, and the schema is the floor
concepts.description: App filters are mirrored by DB CHECKs (affect vocabulary, outbound language, closed kinds, closed features, the publication boundary).

concepts.name: Levels of content, never of people
concepts.description: Nothing is locked. Every level check blocks nothing.

concepts.name: Growth may never take something back
concepts.description: Append-only ledgers, a permanent level floor and frozen historical counts.

concepts.name: NEVER MANIPULATE
concepts.description: as a four-question audit that lives in the file header of every mechanic.

concepts.name: Covert comprehension signals that are not scores:
concepts.description: - near-miss distractor choice (which misconception); - first-try vs eventual correctness; - a changed-situation transfer; - self-explanation ("explain in your own words"); - hint-ladder re-entry (weak-topic); - glossary re-lookups (term-asked); - spaced kept/faded.

concepts.name: The per-model law
concepts.description: Any change of model or lane re-runs the register battery at n≥300 before the flag flips. "A byte-identical prompt lost 38-2 on a different model."

concepts.name: The negative control is the battery
concepts.description: Every gate case is paired with a real string that must not trip it.

concepts.name: Read zeroes with the gate-trip row
concepts.description: A zero produced by a gate says nothing about the model.

concepts.name: Fail closed on money and compliance
concepts.description: An unreadable ledger or unpriced deployment means no spend. An unpaid lane means no learner content sent. "There is never a dead microphone": an unconfigured state is a complete, honest product state.

concepts.name: One list, many callers
concepts.description: Distress shapes, emoji sets and question predicates each have exactly one definition, shared by prompt, gate, eval, memory filter and UI.

concepts.name: Measurement discipline
concepts.description: Every number carries n, method and date. "Not measured" is written as such. A dated lesson in `timeline.md` saved a later pass from re-litigating a false positive.

concepts.name: Evidence is gated on people, not code
concepts.description: Rubrics, a calibration set (κ) and a named accountable owner; until all three exist, the database itself refuses a submission.

concepts.name: An exemplar beside the rubric
concepts.description: never an answer key and never a number.

concepts.name: The vocabulary lock: one word per thing
concepts.description: The vocabulary lock: one word per thing.

concepts.name: DPDP posture
concepts.description: Minimisation and purpose limitation are enforced by DB constraints. The repo argues that the six-kind memory list plus the never-store list *are* a DPDP notice.
